record.title: Senegal–Mauritania reciprocal freight-vehicle entry restrictions with compulsory transshipment, documented within 2018–2025
record.scope: Cross-border through-carriage by Senegalese and Mauritanian freight vehicles; compulsory transfer to local trucks
record.crossings: Rosso; other posts not individually established
record.direction: Reciprocal in participant and retrospective accounts; institutional confirmation specifically Senegal-to-Mauritania.
record.movement: Senegalese freight vehicles entering Mauritania; reciprocal Mauritanian vehicles reported at Rosso.
record.exceptions: Cargo continued after transfer; Moroccan carriers reported operating. Full exemptions not established.
record.imposing_authority: Mauritanian and Senegalese transport/border authorities; source strength differs by direction
record.enforcement: WTO records entry/movement restriction in March 2018; participant describes reciprocal obstruction in 2021; AfDB indexed 2023 report records unmet removal condition.
record.consequences: Compulsory unloading and use of local carriers; no quantified loss adopted.
record.relationship: Distinct from W-023 COVID traveller regime and R15-AN-002 five-hour ferry protest suspension.
record.status_observation: Within-window entry restriction supported; July 11 2025 formal abolition and November 2025 reported lifting retained as different/contested endpoints.
record.context: Bilateral road-transport regime; original rationale not established.
record.uncertainty: Exact onset, original motive, all crossings/exemptions and uninterrupted continuity unknown. Retrospective 2010 claim not converted into onset. Formal July 2025 change differs from November lifting reported later.

historical.duration_note: No interval: unknown onset and/or endpoint; continuity not reconstructed.
